name: Eventiva Test Runner
onCreateCommand: npm install -g pnpm@9 && pnpm add -g nx
postCreateCommand: pnpm install && git submodule update --init tests && (git -C tests fetch origin && BRANCH=$(git -C tests symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's#^refs/remotes/origin/##') && git -C tests checkout ${BRANCH:-main} && git -C tests pull) || echo 'Tests submodule not configured; clone Eventiva/tests manually if needed'
